MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN PLATINUM (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON ______________________ 
 
 Present 
 
 Mariam Saleem Akbar Chief Executive / Director 
 Adil Ahmad Kamal Director 
 
 Mariam Saleem Akbar chaired the meeting (“ Chairman ”). 
 
 Agenda 
 
 AMENDMENT TO THE LOAN AGREEMENT WITH ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to amend the loan agreement dated 4 April October 2019, as amended from time to time (“ Loan Agreement ”), by and between Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited (“ Lender ”) and the Company. 
 
 The Amendment involves converting the amount of the Credit Limit availed by the Company during the term of the Loan Agreement, i.e., Rs. 826,946,320 (“ Loan Amount ”), into 9,800 ordinary shares of the Company (“ Shares ”). The issuance of these Shares will constitute full and final settlement of the Loan Amount and fully dispose of all claims and liabilities of the Company with respect to or arising under the Loan Agreement. 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Mariam Saleem Akbar, Chief Executive of the Company, to discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved , that the Company agrees to amend the Loan Agreement to convert the Loan Amount of Rs. 826,946,320 into 9,800 ordinary shares of the Company, with the issuance of such Shares to Lender constituting full and final settlement of the Loan Amount and fully disposing of all claims and liabilities of the Company with respect to or arising under the Loan Agreement. 
 
 Resolved further , that Mariam Saleem Akbar be and is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds, and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction, including but not limited to the execution of the Amendment to the Loan Agreement and the issuance of the Shares in accordance with applicable laws.
